# laravelforge_server_network (Data Source)

Reads the private-network membership of a Laravel Forge server: the set of other server IDs it can reach.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server whose network membership is read.

### Read-Only

- `servers` (Set of Number) Set of server IDs currently in this server's network.
